tmdb.original_title: এমন দেশটি কোথাও খুঁজে পাবে নাকো তুমি
tmdb.overview: Set against the backdrop of the 37th anniversary of Bangladesh's independence, this psychological drama-thriller explores the intricate social, psychological, and political realities of post-independence Bangladesh. The narrative follows deeply human struggles that mirror the broader challenges, corruption, and evolving state of the nation, blending suspense with sharp socio-political commentary.
tmdb.title: You Will Never Find a Country Like This Anywhere

results.title: Seventy Eight
results.overview: The film "ATATTOR" evolves around Mahesh, a man burdened by guilt and internal conflict as he tries to escape the shadows of his past. His journey takes place, just one day before mahalaya (দেবীপক্ষের সূচনা) where external chaos mirrors his inner turmoil. Mahesh encounters Abhaya, a calm yet intense figure who pushes him to confronts his darkest fears and regrets. Abhaya serves as a symbolic figure of confrontation and resolution, forcing Mahesh to face the moral consequences of his actions.  The backdrop of Durga Puja, combined with ongoing protests, serves to highlight themes of justice, redemption, and the eternal battle between light and darkness. Mahesh's struggle is portrayed as a silent war within himself, representing the fall of his inner demons.

results.title: After the Truth
results.overview: Famous Nazi doctor Josef Mengele — the 'Death Angel of Auschwitz', who killed more than 300.000 people — emerges from his hideout in Argentina to Germany as a 87-year-old man, and must stand for his crimes in court. The young solicitor Peter Rohm is assigned to defend him, but Rohm himself — an expert on Mengele and his crimes — feels unable to do so. When he decides to take on the case, he endangers not only his marriage but also his and his wife's lives.

results.title: Madonnas
results.overview: A portrait of Rita, who claims that her mother was never a mother for her. Rita gives birth to her own five children and forces her mother to take the role of a mother.

results.title: Revolution
results.overview: New York trapper Tom Dobb becomes an unwilling participant in the American Revolution after his son Ned is drafted into the Army by the villainous Sergeant Major Peasy. Tom attempts to find his son, and eventually becomes convinced that he must take a stand and fight for the freedom of the Colonies, alongside the aristocratic rebel Daisy McConnahay. As Tom undergoes his change of heart, the events of the war unfold in large-scale grandeur.

results.title: Osomoy
results.overview: Caught between her middle-class background and her rich university friends, Urbi navigates a world of wealth and privilege. But as she chases her dreams, she falls into a life-changing chaos, paying a high price for her ambitions.

results.title: Extreme Ops
results.overview: While filming an advertisement, some extreme sports enthusiasts unwittingly stop a group of terrorists.

results.title: The Last Kiss
results.overview: First ever Bangladeshi feature film. The film about a conflict between two family members.

results.title: Kismet
results.overview: After doing something sinister, a man cleans and dresses up and leaves the house. Resting beside the river of Padma, he texts to someone and starts to wait. Undesired to him, an annoying man in white dress sits beside him and starts to chatter. Something mysterious awaits him.

results.title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
results.original_title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
results.overview: In 1920s Ireland young doctor Damien O'Donovan prepares to depart for a new job in a London hospital. As he says his goodbyes at a friend's farm, British Black and Tans arrive, and a young man is killed. Damien joins his brother Teddy in the Irish Republican Army, but political events are soon set in motion that tear the brothers apart.

results.title: Gettysburg
results.overview: In the summer of 1863, General Robert E. Lee leads the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia into Gettysburg, Pennsylvania with the goal of marching through to Washington, D.C. The Union Army of the Potomac, under the command of General George G. Meade, forms a defensive position to confront the rebel forces in what will prove to be the decisive battle of the American Civil War.

results.title: Bishorjan
results.overview: A young mother refusing to go see Durga bishorjon with her son. Bishorjon takes place with immense celebrations as the two Bengals drown their Durga idols in the river Ichamati separating them. The young lady remembers one such day after bishorjon in her past.

results.title: Children of War
results.overview: Children of War is a movie based on the true events of the 1971 Genocide. Can we, in search of power, become animals? A genocide; neglected! The first use of rape as a weapon of war; undocumented! The lives of millions; unaccounted! The culprits; unpunished!

results.title: The Grave
results.overview: Shirja Mia is grave digger. He begs from village to village to get death news. Now he has only two things in his life. One is a doll which he bought for his daughter and other is a number which he has got from his ancestors. His ancestors believed that if someone could dig hundred graves he would surely be placed in heaven. But no one could ever reach the target. When shirja was young he came to a Char and got married. They had a lovely daughter named Rahela. He had to go to town for work. Rahela asked for a doll from the town. One day Shirja bought a doll, but he couldn't come back to Char due to bad weather. Next day he heard that the tidal bore had washed out the Char. Later he came back to Char. But he didn't find his daughter and wife anywhere. The Char was full of dead bodies. At that time he started digging graves. When one grave left to reach the hundredth, he falls in big crisis with a girl like his daughter. Will Shirja be able to complete one hundred graves?

results.title: Rocky
results.overview: Rocky Balboa is a Philadelphia club fighter who seems to be going nowhere. But when a stroke of fate puts him in the ring with a world heavyweight champion, Rocky knows that it's his one shot at the big time — a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to go the distance and come out a winner!

results.title: Plus-Minus One Day
results.overview: War criminal Baradla Géza returns after 25 years, alongside his ex-accomplice, Obrád Simon, to the village where he burned occupied homes and executed partisans. The ex squad-leader is chased to this place by his 'heroic deed' and the memory of his love. Like a maniac, he seeks to forgive the villagers for having killed six of his soldiers.

results.title: Labyrinth of Lies
results.overview: A young prosecutor in postwar West Germany investigates a massive conspiracy to cover up the Nazi pasts of prominent public figures.

results.title: Naked Among Wolves
results.overview: Based on a true story of inmates at KZ Buchenwald that risked their lives to hide a small Jewish boy shortly before the liberation of the camp.

results.title: I'm Over Thirty
results.overview: The film is about a young man who was born on the day when Kazakhstan gained its long-awaited independence. The guy's memories start from childhood. The events in his personal life are closely intertwined with what the whole country was going through.

omdb.Actors: Kamal Hossain Babor, Mosharraf Karim, Sohel Khan
omdb.Plot: After the independence from Pakistan, Bangladesh has crossed its 37 years but Sufiya Begum after the loss of her twin sons Shaon and Badhon still hasn't got her independence from Rajakar Mahbub.
